name: com.elguerre.tendero.knowledge
title: Tendero Product Knowledge Extension
description: Extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup. Once negotiated, every product a catalog lookup or a product read returns carries `knowledge`: the product's specs as the shop knows them, each with its source. A value whose source is `description` was proposed by a model from the product's own text and approved by a person; its evidence quotes the exact words and says how well they support the value, measured by an entailment check, 0 to 1. A spec the shop does not know is absent: an agent MUST NOT infer it, and SHOULD say the shop does not know. Values are in the language the request asked for.

evidence.description: What a value or a statement rests on.

support.description: How well the quotes support the value, as measured when it was proposed.

quotes.description: The exact words of the product's own text the value rests on, in the request's language when the shop has them in it.

spec.description: One attribute's value for this product.

attribute.description: The attribute's stable code, the same for every product: what to compare on.

label.description: The attribute's name, in the request's language.

value.description: The value as the shop writes it, unit included.

source.description: `catalogue`: the catalogue holds it, from its import or a person. `description`: a person approved it from the product's own text, and `evidence` says from which words.

statement.description: An approved fact that is a sentence rather than a value, such as 'it has an anti-theft pocket'.

knowledge.description: What the shop knows about one product.

product.description: The member this extension adds to a catalog Product.
